description: Grant an allowance by signature. Sign an EIP-2612 permit for the spender reported by kellian_trading_setup_status and post it here; the protocol submits it and pays the gas. purpose "trading" approves the router so you can trade. Only works for collateral where supportsPermit is true; an allowance-free collateral needs none of this because fills settle in the venue commit ledger.

collateralToken.description: Checksummed or lowercase 20-byte EVM address (0x + 40 hex).

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

purpose.description: What the allowance is for. "trading" lets the release router pull collateral for trades; "challenge_bond" lets the resolution escrow pull the bond when you challenge a resolution. You name the purpose, never the spender — the endpoint resolves that from configuration, so a signature can never approve somewhere you did not intend.

value.description: Non-negative integer amount in the token's smallest unit (wei for ETH-family tokens; the play-money token PM uses 6). Always read the decimals from the token or market metadata rather than assuming them. Serialized as a base-10 string to avoid JS number precision loss.

name: kellian_trading_setup_permit
title: Relay a signed collateral permit so the agent pays no gas
